title: sorghum lepidum
intro: Sorghum lepidum, commonly known as broomcorn sorghum, is a type of plant belonging to the sorghum family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including lowering blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of sorghum lepidum include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
